meaning: M14 passes when the readiness analysis correctly recognizes the optional M4 backend as a strong candidate while blocking default/full replacement claims until all required evidence exists.

claim_boundary.allowed_now: Optional clean-room M4 transition-backend candidate with passing runtime/integration milestones.
claim_boundary.not_allowed_now: Proven full Transvoxel.cpp replacement, official topology equivalent, or default backend replacement.

next_milestone.objective: Prove M4 runtime geometry and seams across all six transition-face orientations using explicit sample/vertex frame transforms in C and Godot.
next_milestone.why_first: This is the nearest self-contained blocker to making M4 the default and creates the orientation machinery required for later official-reference and corner-junction proofs.
